  {s next : Experiments.MindContinuation.OperationalState},
  Experiments.MindContinuation.productiveStep s = some next →

      s.work.pending = event :: remaining ∧
        next.work.pending = remaining ∧
          next.work.receipts = s.work.receipts ++ [receipt] ∧
            receipt.before = s.work.account ∧
              receipt.event = event ∧

                  receipt.after = next.work.account ∧ Experiments.MindContinuation.receiptConsistent receipt

signatures.Experiments.MindContinuation.checkpoint_:
Experiments.MindContinuation.checkpoint_restore_matching_context : ∀ (s : Experiments.MindContinuation.OperationalState)
  (freshFuel freshAdmin : ℕ),
  Experiments.MindContinuation.restore (Experiments.MindContinuation.checkpoint s) s.context freshFuel freshAdmin =
    some { work := s.work, fuel := freshFuel, context := s.context, adminCount := freshAdmin }

Experiments.MindContinuation.checkpoint_restore_rejects_context_mismatch : ∀
  (s : Experiments.MindContinuation.OperationalState) (currentContext freshFuel freshAdmin : ℕ),
  s.context ≠ currentContext →
    Experiments.MindContinuation.restore (Experiments.MindContinuation.checkpoint s) currentContext freshFuel
        freshAdmin =
      none

Experiments.MindContinuation.checkpoint_resume_preserves_continuation : ∀
  (s : Experiments.MindContinuation.OperationalState) (freshFuel freshAdmin : ℕ),
  s.fuel ≥ s.work.pending.length →
    freshFuel ≥ s.work.pending.length →
      (Experiments.MindContinuation.runProductive s.work.pending.length s).work.pending = [] ∧
        Option.map (fun resumed => (Experiments.MindContinuation.runProductive s.work.pending.length resumed).work)
            (Experiments.MindContinuation.restore (Experiments.MindContinuation.checkpoint s) s.context freshFuel
              freshAdmin) =
          some (Experiments.MindContinuation.runProductive s.work.pending.length s).work
